UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: User profile document stored under users/{uid}

uid.description: Unique identifier corresponding to Firebase Auth UID

displayName.description: User display name or email prefix

createdAt.description: Timestamp when user profile was established

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when profile was last updated

PredictionRecord.title: PredictionRecord
PredictionRecord.description: Prediction or forecast audit record under users/{uid}/predictions/{predictionId}

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the record owner

modelId.description: Machine learning model identifier (e.g. xgboost-term-deposit or var2-campaign-forecast)

input.description: Exact input parameters sent to the FastAPI ML backend

output.description: Exact prediction or forecast response returned by the FastAPI ML backend

/users/{userId}/predictions/{predictionI.description: User-isolated ML prediction and forecast history collection
